# Onus Wood

> Australian timber lighting, made to order: pendants, wall sconces, floor lamps, task lamps and candelabras in a choice of Australian hardwoods. Prices in AUD including GST.

## Pieces
- [Cradle pendant](https://onuswood.com/product/cradle-pendant/): A turned timber dome that throws a soft pool of light over a dining table or kitchen bench. From $1,480.
- [Daintree pendant](https://onuswood.com/product/daintree-pendant/): Fine timber slats around a warm glow, like light through a stack of kindling. From $2,280.
- [Flinders pendant](https://onuswood.com/product/flinders-pendant/): An open timber cube with a bare globe at its heart. Joinery you can see straight through. From $1,240.
- [Wollemi wall sconce](https://onuswood.com/product/wollemi-wall-sconce/): A linen shade on a timber arm that washes soft light down a wall. From $640.
- [Otway wall sconce](https://onuswood.com/product/otway-wall-sconce/): Two timber wings that shield the globe and throw light up and down the wall. From $780.
- [Freycinet wall sconce](https://onuswood.com/product/freycinet-wall-sconce/): A small fabric hood on a turned timber mount. Quiet enough for a bedroom. From $460.
- [Barrington floor lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/barrington-floor-lamp/): A slender timber stem and linen drum shade for reading corners. From $1,950.
- [Karijini floor lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/karijini-floor-lamp/): Three timber legs, one generous shade. Our most sculptural floor lamp. From $2,380.
- [Daylesford floor lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/daylesford-floor-lamp/): A compact reading lamp that tucks in beside an armchair. From $1,420.
- [Bright task lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/bright-task-lamp/): Two timber leaves with a line of light between them. From $690.
- [Lorne task lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/lorne-task-lamp/): A small timber stem and paper-white shade for a bedside or shelf. From $680.
- [Myall candelabra](https://onuswood.com/product/myall-candelabra/): A long timber beam carrying a row of lights, made for a kitchen island or a long dining table. From $2,450.
- [Coorong candelabra](https://onuswood.com/product/coorong-candelabra/): Three or four turned timber shades hung from one canopy, in a line over a kitchen island. From $1,980.
- [Kanangra candelabra](https://onuswood.com/product/kanangra-candelabra/): A timber frame with tall glowing rods, built for high ceilings, stairwells and open-plan rooms. From $3,400.
